news.title: Ballon d’Or Goalkeeper of the Year: All nominees
news.lede: And this year, it brings a new set of nominees with results influenced by not just club football, but also the FIFA World Cup 2026. The World Cup had a massive impact on who ended up being nominated and nowhere is this more apparent than with the Yashin Trophy. The Yashin Trophy, named after the goalkeeping legend Lev Yashin, will be awarded to one goalkeeper each in the men’s and women’s categories. This year, ten nominees for men’s and five nominees for women’s have been selected.

news.title: Dani Olmo: ‘Winning the World Cup changes you, it changes your life’
news.lede: One of Barcelona’s eight World Cup winners reflects on how Spain’s triumph is inspiring them in the Champions League. Dani Olmo nods towards his right arm. “Look: goosebumps,” he says. The Spain midfielder is sitting in a back room at Barcelona’s Joan Gamper training ground trying to pinpoint the moment he knew he was a world champion.

news.title: 'Helpless 1-3 Defeat to Ghana': South Korea's U20 Women's Football Team Faces Elimination from World Cup Group Stage
news.lede: The South Korea U-20 women's national football team has been pushed to the brink of elimination from the group stage of the 2026 FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup. Led by head coach Park Yoon-jung, the South Korea U-20 national team suffered a decisive 1-3 defeat to Ghana in the Group C second match of the tournament held at Sosnowiec Arena in Poland at 10 p.m. (Korean time) on the 9th. Earlier, South Korea had drawn 1-1 with France, finishing the group stage with one draw and one loss (one point), placing them last in their group.
